verdict.rationale: Anytype documents reusable Templates: a saved page layout, defined once, that forms the base for every new Object of a Type such as Note, Task or Project. That covers applying templates to recurring kinds of notes, and templates can also be queried through the API. Nothing in the evidence shows dynamic variables such as date or title placeholders being substituted at creation, and that is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: template variables (date/title substitution), hands-on or independent corroboration of template workflows
